text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear opening question and thesis","quality":"organization","description":"It presents a more recognizable introduction, body development, and conclusion than the other essay, which helps the argument feel more structured."},{"evidence":"“after multiple testing and experiments” “driven more than half a million miles without a crash”","quality":"use of evidence","description":"It relies more consistently on article details to support its claims rather than mostly repeating them."},{"evidence":"explains takeovers in driveways and traffic issues","quality":"elaboration","description":"It does more to explain how the evidence supports its position instead of just naming facts."},{"evidence":"“what if you have an incoming phone call”","quality":"reader engagement","description":"It uses a more vivid, relatable example to make the benefits of driverless cars feel immediate."},{"evidence":"“How awesome is that!” “let's get rid of these basic cars”","quality":"persuasive voice","description":"It has a stronger, more energetic stance that makes the essay sound more convincing and purposeful."}]}
